hook_form.ai_raw_json_analysis: Send raw customer json to the AI automatically
hook_form.ai_raw_json_analysis_help:
When enabled, the JSON returned by the customer's third-party API is sent to the AI on every message, inserted as a separate block before the Document.

[RAW_JSON_PROFILE_START]
Raw Json Profile : enable = true
Raw Json =
{ ... }
[RAW_JSON_PROFILE_END]

The complete payload is sent, including success and status, so the AI can distinguish "the customer has no data" from "the system could not retrieve the data". These two cases require different answers.

The conditions for using this data are defined in the "Rules for Using Raw JSON Data" field below. That text is sent after the data block and before the Document.

Payloads exceeding 20,000 characters are truncated and marked with "_truncated": true.

Disabled by default. Existing hooks retain their current behaviour until enabled.

hook_form.ai_site_rules_guide_help:
Text written here is sent to the AI right after the Site Rules data block, telling it how that block should be used.

Only applies when the "Send Site Rules to AI" switch above is on. Leaving it empty is fine — the data is sent without any rules.

This is separate from "Rules for Using Raw JSON Data", which governs the customer data. This one governs the website rules.
hook_form.auto_inject_hint: (Inserted automatically when enabled — no need to reference it yourself)
hook_form.ai_raw_json_rules_help:
Instructions for the AI on how to interpret the raw data block. Required when raw JSON analysis is enabled.

The text is sent verbatim as its own block, positioned after the data and before the Document:

[RAW_JSON_PROFILE_RULES_START]
<the text entered here>
[RAW_JSON_PROFILE_RULES_END]

Recommended contents:
- state that the data reflects the customer's current status
- state which source takes precedence when the data and the Document disagree
- prohibit reproducing JSON structure or field names in the reply
- define the response when success is false or status is not 2xx

The text is sent only while the switch above is enabled.
hook_form.ai_raw_json_rules_placeholder:
Apply the following rules to the block delimited by [RAW_JSON_PROFILE_START] and [RAW_JSON_PROFILE_END]:
- The data reflects this customer's current status.
- Where the data and the Document disagree, the data takes precedence.
- Do not reproduce JSON structure or field names in the reply.
- If success is false or status is not 2xx, state that the information cannot be verified. Do not substitute an assumed value.

hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_swiftcheck: ① Swiftcheck — the slip gate (no bindable state in this block)
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_swiftcheck_des: Checks the slip is real, readable, and not a duplicate · only a pass (slip.api_status = success) enters payment and ALWAYS continues to topup · a reject or duplicate is answered by Swiftcheck's own cards and ends there
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_topup: ② topup (shop-api) — the main credit path, always fired
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_topup_desc: Decides from the slip image · process-wallet = credited, STOP, walletpay never runs · CUSTOMER_NOT_LINKED / member-not-match = stop before walletpay (link first / the sender is not this customer, walletpay cannot judge that) · fail / account-not-match / duplicate = continue to walletpay because nothing was credited and walletpay may still pair the slip
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_gate: ③ Before walletpay — our own statement matcher
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_gate_desc: Finds a pending deposit (provider walletpay · waiting-deposit) whose amount equals the slip exactly, to take its refId (info.trade_no) · none found = ends on the state below, walletpay never called because there is no refId to call with
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_walletpay: ④ walletpay — the fallback path, also decides from the image
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_walletpay_desc: Uploads the slip to one refId at a time · matched + confirmed = credited, STOP · matched not confirmed = admin confirms · no_match = ask the customer to try the next statement · a 4000/4040 reject = skip that statement (nothing uploaded) and walk on
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_system: ⑤ The system endings — no provider decided
hook_form.payflex_eye_sec_system_desc: Every undecidable path ends here: topup timeout · an unreadable walletpay answer · every statement tried without a match — the slip stays locked for an admin because money may already have moved
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_topup_success: Produced by: topup (shop-api) — HTTP 200, data.slip_status.status = "process-wallet" · no live capture yet (per contract)
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_walletpay_succ: Produced by: walletpay — HTTP 200, matchResult.status = "matched" + confirmed = true · real capture below
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_matched_pendin: Produced by: walletpay — HTTP 200, matchResult.status = "matched" + confirmed = false (PROCESSING) · real capture below (partial)
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_no_match_retry: Produced by: walletpay — HTTP 200, messageType = "SINGLE_NOT_MATCHED" (or matchResult.status = "no_match") with statements remaining · real capture below
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_statement_not_: Produced by: our own runner after topup did not credit — no statement equals the amount, so there is no provider HTTP · or walletpay rejected before accepting the file (code 4000/4040/4001 — real captures below), which ends on this same card
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_not_linked: Produced by: topup (shop-api) — HTTP 404, error.code = "CUSTOMER_NOT_LINKED" · real capture below
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_member_not_mat: Produced by: topup (shop-api) — HTTP 200, data.slip_status.status = "member-not-match" · no full body captured yet (confirmed from the live flow 2026-08-10)
hook_form.payflex_eye_src_review: Produced by: several paths — topup timeout/network (no response) · a 2xx walletpay answer that cannot be read · or every statement tried on walletpay without a match (see the no_match raw above — the last statement ends here)
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_topup_success: topup (shop-api) answered slip_status = process-wallet ⇒ outcome SUCCESS · slip locked success · walletpay is never called
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_topup_succes: The money reached the customer's wallet through the main top-up path — this card is what they see on a successful top-up
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_walletpay_suc: walletpay answered matched + confirmed:true (paired via the refId on a pending statement) ⇒ outcome SUCCESS · slip locked success
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_walletpay_su: Money credited through the fallback path — the slip was paired with the customer's pending deposit; to the customer it looks like a normal successful top-up
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_matched_pendi: walletpay answered matched but confirmed:false ⇒ outcome MATCHED_PENDING · slip locked matched_pending · queued for review (awaiting_admin_confirm)
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_matched_pend: Paired, but an admin still has to confirm — no money credited yet, so the card must not read as success
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_no_match_retr: walletpay answered no_match with statements remaining ⇒ outcome AWAITING_RETRY · the run pauses at resume_cursor = the next statement · the button sends paylink.retry so the BE continues with the SAME slip
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_no_match_ret: The slip did not pair with the first pending deposit; the customer is asked whether to try the next one — tapping retry reuses the same slip, no resend needed
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_statement_not: No statement equals the slip amount (exact match) ⇒ walletpay never called · outcome RELEASED · slip not locked · the amount-mismatch case also opens an admin ticket
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_statement_no: The slip amount matches none of the customer's pending deposits; the slip is released, they can resend immediately, and an admin follows up
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_not_linked: topup answered 404 code CUSTOMER_NOT_LINKED ⇒ outcome RELEASED · not locked · walletpay never called
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_not_linked: This LINE has no linked web account — the customer links their account first, then sends the same slip again
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_member_not_ma: topup answered slip_status = member-not-match ⇒ stops BEFORE walletpay · outcome RELEASED + needs_review · the BE opens a ticket automatically (the only state that does)
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_member_not_m: The account that transferred the money is not this customer's own — the system opens a case so an admin takes over right away
hook_form.payflex_eye_tech_review: topup timeout / walletpay answer unreadable / every statement tried without a match ⇒ outcome REVIEW · slip locked timeout · needs_review for an admin
hook_form.payflex_eye_plain_review: The system cannot decide on its own and money may already have moved; the slip stays locked for an admin — never tell the customer it failed or was cancelled
